sloka: पुत्रस्तस्यामरेशेन इन्द्रेणाद्य निपातितः ।राहोर्वचनमास्थाय ततः स कुपितो ऽनिलः ।। ७.३५.५९ ॥
transliteration: putrastasyāmareśena indreṇādya nipātitaḥ ।rāhorvacanamāsthāya tataḥ sa kupito 'nilaḥ ।। 7.35.59 ॥

translations.english: Vayu's son was struck down by Indra, the lord of immortals, today, acting upon the advice of Rahu, which is why Vayu became enraged.
